about: Modwerk source-only sample-rate package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/sample-rate.

mods.title: Sample RATE
mods.summary: FIN's knob becomes RATE, sound by sound: pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse, like the Octatrack's RATE on PTCH. Tap the knob to switch.
mods.description: FIN's knob becomes RATE, sound by sound: pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse, like the Octatrack's RATE on PTCH. Tap the knob to switch.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in a 16-module combined image (LF01, as reported); this package has not run alone on a unit.
